packageRules.description: One weekly MR for every non-major update. Wintermute reviews it and posts a recommendation before a human merges.
Major versions: one MR each, never grouped.
Authentik is far behind (2025.2.4 on 2026-11-22): step through one release at a time, each in its own MR.
Game servers: off for now. Merging a compose change runs `docker compose up -d`, which starts a stopped server. Enable once the deploy skips stopped stacks.
